reviews.title: Its all about the money
reviews.text:
There is no point of this - they claim that you can get a reading based on your answers, but you have to pay. I paid, and afterwards, i was instructed to go in chat and ask them about reading. Well, you ask a question, and then all of a sudden, the psychic is busy, but the timer doesnt stop, and after a few minutes you have to pay again, to get a few minutes in chat. So - constant paying for every little thing.

UPD.: As the developer in his answer doesnt acknowledge any of the problems, im gonna add to review. I was put on subscribtion without agreeing or approving to do so. Thankfully, I noticed it right away and was able to cancel it and delete my account. The thing is - when you purchase something, they dont tell you that you will have to keep purchasing things, so the subscribtion or starting fee are absolute scams. As for the developer answer - just own up to it and fix it. If not, I have no problem to keep putting updates that I have heard from other users and warning people who want this app.
reviews.reply:
Hello dear user!

Thanks for your feedback.

We are very sorry to hear that our app didn’t meet your expectations and that you had payment issues. We apologize for any confusion!

Feel free to contact our support service at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com, so we could help you to solve this problem.

Have a good day 🔮

reviews.title: WARNING‼️SCAM‼️
reviews.text: I did a test that showed on my Instagram page to get a palm reading, paid 5€ for that and then I was redirected to some app looking page in my browser where I did not do anything because I did not want to pay any more. A week later 45€ was gone from my bank account to another Nebula bank account, I checked wether there were some subscriptions or anything that I could’ve missed, but couldn’t find any so I texted the support team. They said that they can’t find a problem and did not pay me back. It was very unprofessional from their side, but I let that slide, until a little before one month from that I saw the same thing again - they had stolen 45€ more. I went searching into the website and found some subscription or what (which I didn’t agree on and didn’t even know about) on 39,99€, canceled that and texted the support team again. This time THEY DIDN’T EVEN ANSWER me. That was about a week ago and I have texted them twice! Still got no reply..
